import sys

class CBubbleStrike:
    def getProb(self, x, n):
        return (3.0 / 2.0) * x / n * (n - x) / (n - 1) * (n - x - 1) / (n - 2) + \
               3.0 * x / n * (x - 1) / (n - 1) * (n - x) / (n - 2) + \
               1.0 * x / n * (x - 1) / (n - 1) * (x - 2) / (n - 2)

    def solve(self):
        input_data = sys.stdin.read().strip().split()
        n = int(input_data[0])
        p = float(input_data[1])
        x = 0
        while self.getProb(x, n) < p:
            x += 1
        print(x)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    solver = CBubbleStrike()
    solver.solve()
